docs.title: API documentation
docs.subtitle: Generate styled QR codes from your code with one HTTP request.

intro.body: The QrAPI API exposes a single endpoint that generates QR codes with every editor style: gradients, dot shapes, custom corners, logos and frames. It returns the image directly (PNG, SVG or JPEG), ready to use.

quickstart.body: From zero to your first QR in under a minute.
quickstart.step1Body: Sign up for free, go to Dashboard → API keys and generate a key. Copy it: it is shown only once.
quickstart.step2Body: Call GET /api/v1/qr with your key in the Authorization header and your content in the data parameter.
quickstart.step3Body: The response is the image itself. Pick png, svg or jpeg with the format parameter and the size with size.

auth.body: Every request requires an API key in the Authorization header. Create yours for free from the dashboard: sign up, go to API keys and generate one. The full key is shown only once.
auth.warning: Treat your key like a password: don't commit it to repositories or use it from the browser in production.

generate.getBody: For basic QRs, pass parameters in the query string. Great for quick testing.
generate.postBody: For gradients, custom corners, logos and frames, send a JSON body. You can pass `data` (raw text) or `payload` (a typed object that builds the standard format for you: WiFi, vCard, email…).

rows.payload: Typed object alternative to data, with type: wifi | vcard | email | url | text | phone | sms | crypto, plus each type's fields
rows.format: Output format: png, svg or jpeg
rows.size: Width in pixels (64–2048). Ignored for svg
rows.ecLevel: Error correction: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%)
rows.style: Full style object: dots (with gradient), cornersSquare, cornersDot, background
rows.logo: Centered logo: dataUri (base64, max 500 KB), sizeRatio (0.1–0.35), margin, background
rows.frame: Decorative frame: style, text, color, optional textColor

errors.body: Errors are returned as JSON with this shape:

rows.invalid_params: Invalid query parameters (the details field tells you which)
rows.data_too_long: The content does not fit in a QR at that correction level

rateLimits.body: Each API key has these limits. Every response includes the X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset headers; a 429 adds Retry-After in seconds.

tryIt.body: Paste your API key and generate a real QR against this instance. The key is never stored anywhere.
